meta.notes: The tutorial's quiet mission for two, the truck park: a haulier's yard at night with one partner, on its own ground. One line: a man taken by the partner on the word, two men who watch each other taken on one beat (the partner's and the player's own), a man held and asked for a door code while the partner throws the mains, then the office in the dark and out by the far gate. Generated by tools/levels/tut-pair.ts.

steps.line: Press [C] to crouch. Your partner will copy you
Press [B] on that guard to send your partner after him

after.line: He's working his way around behind the guard

explain.title: Two of you
explain.text:
Your partner follows you and stays as quiet as you do.
Press [B] on a guard to send your partner around behind him. He'll say "set" when he's there, and then he'll wait for you to say go.

steps.line: Press [F] to say go, and he'll take the guard down

after.word: He's taking the guard down, then he'll come back to you

steps.line: Lead him to the gap between the containers
Press [B] on the far guard to send your partner after him

explain.title: Two guards at once
explain.text:
These two can see each other, so if you take down just one, the other will shout.
Give your partner the far one, then get behind the near one yourself. When you grab yours, he'll take his.

steps.line: Get behind the near guard and wait for "set"
{Grab him from behind}, and your partner will take his
He knows the door code. {Grab him from behind}
Press [Space] to ask him for the code
Your hands are full. Press [B] on the breaker box

after.line: He's going for the breaker box. Watch the lights

explain.title: Your partner can use things too
explain.text:
Press [B] on anything you could use yourself, and your partner will go use it.
The light and the camera over the office door both run off this breaker box.

steps.line: Press [N] to turn on night vision
Press [Space] at the keypad to enter his code
Press [Space] at the trunk to take the manifest
Press [B] on the ground to call your partner, then leave through the far gate
